exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Navy Corpus Clearance, <callsign>, put a ZOMBIE 1 on request, time immediate.

exchange.speaker: Clearance
exchange.text: <callsign>, Navy Corpus Clearance, roger, on request.

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Navy Corpus Clearance, <callsign>, ZOMBIE 1 on request, ready to copy.

exchange.speaker: Clearance
exchange.text: <callsign>, Navy Corpus Clearance, for VFR flight, squawk <code>.

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Navy Corpus Ground, <callsign>, holding short Charlie, taxi with ATIS <code>, VFR KINGS 4.

exchange.speaker: Ground
exchange.text: <callsign>, Navy Corpus Ground, taxi to RWY 13L via <taxiway>.

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Navy Corpus Ground, <callsign>, taxi to RWY 13L via <taxiway>.

cards.title: Call Tower when number one
cards.leadIn: Do not call while waiting in sequence:
instructions: State departure intentions and any additional requests

radio.script: “Navy Corpus Tower, <callsign>, ready for departure, VFR KINGS 4.”

cards.title: Initial climb
instructions: Climb initially to 500 ft MSL at 200 KIAS
Do not commence turns before 300 ft AGL

cards.title: Check in with Corpus Departure
cards.leadIn: At 500 ft MSL, when directed by Tower:

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Corpus Departure, <callsign>, 500 feet off Navy Corpus, course rules KINGS 4.

exchange.speaker: Departure
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Departure, radar contact <distance and direction> of Navy Corpus. Proceed course rules KINGS 4.

cards.detail: The binder also places a CH 12 switch in the High Bridge “Thence” sequence. This guide models one CH 12 contact; verify the exact transfer timing with an instructor.

cards.title: Fly Runway 13L heading to High Bridge
Abeam the High Bridge
instructions: Climb initially and maintain 2,500 ft MSL

cards.title: Continue to Point Rusty
instructions: When cleared on course by Corpus Approach, climb and maintain 5,500 ft MSL
Maintain 5,500 ft MSL up to Point Rusty
Expect switch to Corpus Approach (UHF CH 6) when directed

cards.title: At Point Rusty
instructions: For KINGS 4, begin climb to 14,500 ft MSL
Enter the MOA via the approved entry procedure when cleared

cards.title: Obtain KINGS 4 clearance
cards.leadIn: When directed by Corpus Approach, before entering the MOA:

cards.title: Claim Area 3 High
cards.leadIn: Before proceeding to the selected block:
instructions: Wait for responses before claiming the area

radio.script: “99 KINGS 4, anybody working area 3 high?” After responses: “99 KINGS 4, <callsign> claims area 3 high.”

cards.title: Enter KINGS 4 through the transition layer
instructions: When cleared, enter via the transition layer
Maintain 14,500 ft MSL until within the lateral confines of the MOA
Once within the MOA, use the appropriate transition altitude: east 14,700 ft MSL; west 14,200 ft MSL
cards.detail: Area 3 is a border block. The map shows the KML boundary, not an approved entry track.

cards.title: Work Area 3 High
instructions: Maintain a listening watch with Houston Center
Use the Navy Corpus altimeter setting
Area 3 High limits: 15,000–22,000 ft MSL; these are block limits, not an assigned altitude
